use_cases.title: Open a savings account online
use_cases.description: A prospective customer opens a savings account on the web through a four-step wizard that starts on Account type, moves through About you, Fund it, and Review, keeps the current step visible and completed steps checked, allows back-navigation from step two onward, and only lets the applicant leave the identity step when required personal and contact details are present and correctly formed; in this demo scope the flow ends at “Open account” without real KYC, credit checks, money movement, or session persistence between visits.
use_cases.summary: Open a savings account through the web wizard.
use_cases.value: Acquires savings-account applications without a branch visit while screening out obviously invalid applicant data before downstream verification.

cite.quote: - A first-time visitor can open a savings account in under 5 minutes.

cites.quote: - A first-time visitor can open a savings account in under 5 minutes.

The application is a four-step wizard with a visible stepper:
**Account type → About you → Fund it → Review**. The primary button reads
"Continue →" on the first three steps and "Open account" on the final step.
A "← Back" control returns to the previous step from step two onward.

Step two collects identity and contact details. We must not let an
applicant advance with incomplete or malformed data, because downstream
verification would reject it.

Validation runs when the user attempts to continue. Invalid fields show an
inline error message beneath the field, and the user stays on the step.

- Real KYC, credit checks, or money movement. This is a demo surface.
- Mobile-specific layouts, native apps, and localization.
- Saving or persisting applicant data between sessions.

use_cases.title: Calculate a federal income tax estimate
use_cases.description: A prospective customer uses the Federal Income Tax Calculator to estimate either a federal refund or an amount owed, with results recalculated live as inputs change, no submit action, and no page reload; the calculator presents an ordered estimate breakdown, applies filing-status-based standard deductions or reveals an itemized-deductions input when Itemized is chosen, floors taxable income at zero, and displays values as whole-dollar US currency.
use_cases.summary: Estimate a federal refund or amount owed live.
use_cases.value: Helps visitors estimate tax outcome and decide how much they may want to deposit.

cite.quote:

cites.quote:

- The tax calculator returns a correct estimate that updates instantly as
  inputs change, with no page reload.

At `/bank-clone-app/calculators`, the calculator estimates a federal refund
or amount owed. It is a live calculation — results update as the user types,
with no submit button and no page reload.

The estimate panel shows, in order: Gross income, Deductions, Taxable
income, Tax liability, and Taxes withheld, followed by a total labelled
either "Estimated refund" or "Estimated amount you owe".

- Filing status selects the standard deduction: Single $14,600, Married
  filing jointly $29,200, Head of household $21,900.
- Gross income is the annual income the user entered, shown as currency.
- Taxable income is gross income minus the deduction, floored at zero.
- Choosing "Itemized" reveals an itemized deductions input.
- Amounts are displayed as whole-dollar US currency.

use_cases.title: Compare savings account products
use_cases.description: A prospective customer reviews the savings products offered on the Open Account page before entering personal data, sees each product’s APY and minimum opening deposit up front, and can rely on High-Yield Savings being preselected while still changing the choice to another highlighted product.
use_cases.summary: Review and compare available savings products.
use_cases.value: Lets visitors make an informed product choice before beginning the application.

cite.quote:
Prospective customers need to (a) compare our savings products and open an
account without visiting a branch, and (b) estimate their federal tax
refund so they can decide how much to deposit. This PRD covers the
**Open Account** flow and the **Federal Income Tax Calculator**.

cites.quote:
Prospective customers need to (a) compare our savings products and open an
account without visiting a branch, and (b) estimate their federal tax
refund so they can decide how much to deposit. This PRD covers the

- Rates and product terms are visible before any personal data is requested.

The Open Account page presents exactly three savings products. Every
product is fee-free and shows its annual percentage yield and minimum
opening deposit up front.

**High-Yield Savings is selected by default** when the page loads, since it
is our most popular account. Selecting a different product highlights it as
the chosen option.

use_cases.title: Move between the Open Account and Calculators pages

use_cases.summary: Navigate between the site’s two main banking areas.
use_cases.value: Supports exploration across related banking tools without forcing browser-back navigation.

without using the browser's back button.
